sentences.en: The locomotive was pulling a long line of freight cars.
sentences.zh: 这台机车拖着一列长长的货车。

sentences.en: He hopped on a freight train bound for New York.
sentences.zh: 他跳上了一列开往纽约的货运火车。

sentences.en: To wish another well bears more freight in Italian.
sentences.zh: 向别人送上美好的祝愿在意大利语里意义更重大。

senses.zh: 装货，运送，使充满(某种心情或口气)
